name: Geometric Truth & Representation Contract

Level0_CanonicalBRep.purpose: Primary engineering truth for solid parts, static assembly interference, exact volume

Level1_ExactTessellation.format: Indexed Triangle Mesh { vertices: Float64Array, indices: Uint32Array, normals: Float64Array }
Level1_ExactTessellation.purpose: Surface-to-surface distance, CAM toolpath verification, gouge detection
Level1_ExactTessellation.authority: AUTHORITATIVE_SURFACE (When chordal deviation <= 0.005mm and angular deviation <= 0.5 deg)

Level2_ConvexSweptHull.purpose: Continuous motion sweep approximation between trajectory poses
Level2_ConvexSweptHull.authority: CONSERVATIVE_BOUNDING (Guaranteed superset of true swept geometry)

Level3_HierarchicalBoundingVolume.purpose: Broad-phase pair rejection and ray/frustum acceleration

forbiddenPractices: Using Level 3 Bounding Volumes to claim exact clearance or collision status
Sampling only triangle vertices while ignoring face/edge geometry in Level 1
Decoupling mesh tessellation from the underlying B-Rep revision hash
